items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny would say, “I got it. I got it. I got it.” You can hear him saying that on record – say it to Monk and me.

ctx.x: Listening to that, he laid out a lot too, whenever Johnny was playing. That’s very rare, because – he was laying out a lot in those sessions.
Yeah. Johnny would say, “I got it. I got it. I got it.” You can hear him saying that on record – say it to Monk and me.
Let’s go back to ’54, your trip to Europe.
